judgement.one_sentence_verdict: A cheerful, well-exposed blue sky with puffy cumulus, but the cloud shapes are common and the composition is slightly undercut by the building edge.
strengths: pleasant puffy cumulus with soft shading
good contrast between cloud and sky
weaknesses: building and statue intrude at bottom edge
